title: Present simple + in / on / at
title_it: Present simple e in / on / at
goal: Talk about routines and facts, and use at, on and in with time.
goal_it: Parlare di routine e fatti e usare at, on e in con il tempo.

steps.title: Present simple: habits and facts
en: We use the present simple for habits, routines, facts and timetables.
With I, you, we and they the verb does not change. With he, she and it we add -s.
it: Usiamo il present simple per abitudini, routine, fatti e orari.
Con I, you, we e they il verbo non cambia. Con he, she e it si aggiunge -s.

examples.en: I walk to work every day.
examples.it: Vado al lavoro a piedi ogni giorno.

steps.title: The -s ending: spelling
en: For he, she and it, most verbs just add -s. Some verbs change a little.
it: Per he, she e it la maggior parte dei verbi prende solo -s. Alcuni cambiano un po'.

head: Rule
Example
rows: watch → watches, finish → finishes, go → goes

steps.title: Negatives and questions
en: We use do / does for negatives and questions. After does or doesn't the verb has no -s: the -s is already in does.
it: Per negative e domande usiamo do / does. Dopo does o doesn't il verbo non ha la -s: la -s è già in does.

examples.en: Does your sister live in Rome?

steps.q_it: Mio fratello gioca a calcio il sabato.
steps.why: My brother = he, so we add -s: plays.
steps.why_it: My brother = he, quindi aggiungiamo -s: plays.

steps.why: They does not take -s. We say: they live.
steps.why_it: They non vuole la -s. Si dice: they live.

steps.q_it: Lei guarda la TV ogni sera.
steps.why_it: I verbi che finiscono in -ch prendono -es: watches.

steps.q: I ___ (not like) coffee in the evening.
steps.q_it: Non mi piace il caffè la sera.
steps.why: With I we use don't + the base verb: don't like.
steps.why_it: Con I si usa don't + verbo base: don't like.

steps.why: Your sister = she, so we use Does.
steps.why_it: Your sister = she, quindi si usa Does.

steps.why: Consonant + y: change y to -ies. Studies.
steps.why_it: Consonante + y: la y diventa -ies. Studies.

steps.why: Doesn't already carries the -s, so the verb stays like: doesn't like.
steps.why_it: Doesn't contiene già la -s, quindi il verbo resta like: doesn't like.

answers: Do you speak English at home
steps.why: Do + subject + base verb + the rest.
steps.why_it: Do + soggetto + verbo base + il resto.

steps.title: Time with at, on and in
steps.title_it: Il tempo con at, on e in
en: Three small words, three jobs. At is for clock times and fixed points. On is for days and dates. In is for longer periods.
it: Tre parole piccole, tre usi. At per le ore e i momenti fissi. On per i giorni e le date. In per i periodi più lunghi.

head: Word
Use
Examples
rows: at 7 o'clock, at night, at the weekend, at Christmas
on Monday, on 5 November, on Friday morning
months, years, seasons, parts of the day
in November, in 2026, in winter, in the morning

examples.en: I see my friends on Saturday.
examples.it: Vedo i miei amici il sabato.

examples.en: We go on holiday in August.
I never drink coffee at night.
examples.it: Non bevo mai caffè di notte.

steps.q_it: Il mio compleanno è a marzo.

steps.why: Parts of the day take in: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.
steps.why_it: Le parti del giorno vogliono in: in the morning, in the afternoon, in the evening.

steps.q_it: Il negozio apre alle 9 nei giorni feriali.
steps.why: At for the clock time, on for days: at 9 o'clock on weekdays.
steps.why_it: At per l'ora, on per i giorni: at 9 o'clock on weekdays.

answers: I get up at seven on weekdays
steps.why: Clock time with at, days with on.
steps.why_it: Ora con at, giorni con on.

cards.ex: She always drinks tea in the morning.
I usually get up at seven.
We often eat out on Fridays.
He sometimes works at the weekend.
They never drink coffee at night.
I walk to work every day.
What do you do at the weekend?
The timetable says the bus leaves at ten.
